declarations.docstring: An integer-valued function attached to a partition.
Characterizes permutations preserving the displayed partition-derived function in lexicographic order.
Permuting the displayed partition-derived function gives a lexicographically bounded function.
The canonical integer-valued function on a finite index type.
A permutation preserves the descending index function exactly when it is the identity.
Permuting the descending index function is lexicographically bounded by the original.
The descending index function is strictly antitone.
A permutation preserves a strictly antitone function exactly when it is the identity.
Permuting a strictly antitone function is lexicographically bounded by that function.
A nonidentity permutation makes a strictly antitone function lexicographically smaller.
Lexicographic order reverses under subtraction from a common function.
Strict lexicographic order reverses under subtraction from a common function.
